verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Copilot can respond to prompts, automate repetitive tasks on request, and take multi-step actions via Cowork/Browse with Copilot, but there is no mention of user-defined rules or event-triggered automation (e.g., 'when X happens, do Y' style triggers). This is distinct from proactive research suggestions, which are model-driven not user-defined rules. Missing for full: any evidence of a rules/trigger engine, scheduled or event-based automation configuration.
